title: Childcare Registration Permission Slip Form
subtitle: An original operational permission slip for childcare registration that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Childcare Registration Permission Slip Form supports the complete childcare registration workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Childcare Registration Permission Slip Form when the assigned childcare enrollment lead needs one fillable record for child enrollment, daily care routing, authorized release, and onboarding without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Childcare registration permission slip identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this permission slip to one child enrollment, daily care routing, authorized release, and onboarding record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Childcare registration record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Childcare registration scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Childcare registration requested participation and permission scope
sections.guidance: Separate each requested activity and condition so one choice does not imply another.

blocks.label: Childcare registration permission choices
items: Participation in the named childcare program and schedule
Routine indoor and outdoor program activities
Meals or snacks only under the current documented plan
Local walk or transport only when separately described
Use of approved comfort, communication, or accessibility supports
Emergency contact through supplied guardian routes
Release only to the documented authorized-person process
Declined optional activities recorded separately from core enrollment
blocks.guidance: Each item is independent; document any exclusion or condition in the scope table.

blocks.label: Permission and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records childcare registration and operations; it does not decide legal custody, diagnose a child, prescribe care, grant blanket consent, or replace emergency services. Stop enrollment, activity, or release when identity, guardian direction, authorized pickup, health support, or safety is unresolved. Limit sensitive information to the approved record and route decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Childcare registration guardian routing, readiness, and support review
sections.guidance: Confirm contact, release, support, and stop conditions before relying on the permission record.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring review before participation
items: Guardian or emergency contact route is incomplete
Requested schedule or room placement is unavailable
Authorized pickup information is unclear or disputed
Required health, allergy, medication, or support review is pending
Child arrives before enrollment or start approval is complete
Release restriction or confidential record needs authorized review
Child becomes ill, injured, missing, or in immediate distress
Enrollment, attendance, billing, or record identity does not reconcile

blocks.label: Participation support, limitation, owner, and evidence
Guardian questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

fields.label: Questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

sections.title: Childcare registration permission decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Preserve approved, declined, conditional, and unresolved scope as separate decisions.

blocks.label: Childcare registration permission decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the childcare administrator, guardian, and qualified health or support reviewer.

blocks.label: Decision rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

fields.label: Rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

sections.title: Childcare registration permission exceptions and operating handoff
sections.guidance: Do not force agreement; assign unresolved scope and communicate operating limits.

blocks.label: Permission exception and stop indicators
items: Enrollment or placement cannot proceed as requested
Guardian, emergency contact, or release route is incomplete
Required health, allergy, medication, or support review is pending
Child is present while enrollment authority remains unclear
Immediate illness, injury, missing-child, or safety response is active
Daily release, attendance, or onboarding closeout is unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, immediate control, owner, escalation, and disposition
Approved-scope handoff requirements
items: Approved and declined scope communicated to assigned staff
Conditions and stop points visible at the point of use
Guardian and qualified-review sources linked
Release, transport, or setting limits routed when applicable
Unresolved permission has an owner and due point
Completion evidence and record location identified

sections.title: Childcare registration outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Childcare registration closeout controls
items: Enrollment or daily status accepted by assigned staff
Guardian communication and next action recorded
Authorized pickup and emergency routes are available
Private health and support records are in approved custody
Open onboarding item has an owner and due point
Childcare record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Permission Slip closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
